label: Bar Label Rotation
description: Grouped bars with the value and series name written vertically inside each bar.
howTo: Bind `xAxis.data` to the list of category names and each `series[n].data` to a list of numbers of the same length.
The label text comes from the template `{c}  {name|{a}}`: `{c}` is the value and `{a}` the series name, so renaming a series in `series[n].name` renames its labels.
All series share one label object in this example. In the Designer each `series[n].label` is its own copy: change `rotate`, `position` or `fontSize` on each series.

label: Stacked Column
description: Several stacks side by side: downtime minutes by cause, planned and unplanned, with a min-to-max line on the total.
howTo: Series with the same `stack` name are stacked on one another; series without `stack` stand alone. Each `series[n].data` is a list of numbers, one per entry in `xAxis.data`.
To build the series from a query, return one row per series and use a script or expression transform to produce `{name, type: "bar", stack, data}` objects, then bind `series` as a whole.
The dashed line on `Unplanned total` is `markLine.data: [[{type: "min"}, {type: "max"}]]`: one line from the lowest to the highest bar of that series.

label: Bar with Negative Values
description: Horizontal bars around zero: energy generated, consumed and the net balance per day, with labels.
howTo: Bind `yAxis.data` to the category list and each `series[n].data` to a list of numbers. Consumption is supplied as negative numbers; nothing else makes those bars point left.
`Generated` and `Consumed` share `stack: "Total"` so they sit on one row; `Net` is a separate bar.

label: Bars with Min / Max / Average
description: Two bar series by month with max and min pins, an average line and a toolbox.
howTo: Bind `xAxis.data` and each `series[n].data` (numbers). The pins and the average line are computed by the chart from the bound data: nothing to bind for them.
To mark a fixed target instead of the average, replace the `markLine.data` entry with `{yAxis: 100, name: "Target"}` and bind that `yAxis` value.
The toolbox buttons (switch to line or bar, restore, save as image) work in a running session; remove `toolbox` to hide them.

label: Mixed Line and Bar
description: Two bar series on the left axis and a line on a second axis on the right, with a shared crosshair.
howTo: Bind `xAxis.data` and each `series[n].data`. A series is drawn against the right-hand axis when it has `yAxisIndex: 1`.
The two axes have fixed `min`, `max` and `interval` so that their grid lines coincide. Bind those to your ranges, or remove them and add `alignTicks: true` to the second axis.

label: Multiple Y Axes
description: Three value axes, each in the colour of its series: two bar series on the right-hand axes and a line on the left.
howTo: Each series picks its axis with `yAxisIndex` (0 = Flow, 1 = Level, 2 = Temperature). Bind `series[n].data` to lists of numbers and `xAxis.data` to the categories.
The axis colours are set in `yAxis[n].axisLine.lineStyle.color` and match the `color` list at the top. Change both together.
The second right-hand axis is moved outwards with `offset: 70`; `grid.right` leaves room for both. Increase both if your axis labels are wider.

label: Horizontal Grouped Bars
description: Horizontal bars comparing two periods per line, largest at the bottom.
howTo: Bind `yAxis.data` to the category names and each `series[n].data` to numbers. Categories are drawn bottom to top; add `inverse: true` to `yAxis` to list them top to bottom.

label: Tangential Polar Bar
description: Bars as arcs around a ring: one ring per machine, arc length is the value.
howTo: Bind `radiusAxis.data` to the names (innermost ring first) and `series.data` to the values. `angleAxis.max` is the value of a full circle.
The label template `{b}: {c}` writes name and value on each arc, which is why the radius axis labels are hidden.

label: Radial Polar Bar
description: Bars as wedges growing from the centre: one wedge per machine, radius is the value.
howTo: Bind `angleAxis.data` to the names and `series.data` to the values. `radiusAxis.max` fixes the outer edge; remove it to scale to the data.

label: Timeline: Bars and Pie by Year
description: A timeline that plays through four years, switching the bars and a pie together. Uses baseOption plus one option per step.
howTo: The option has two parts: `baseOption` holds everything that stays the same, and `options` holds one entry per timeline step with only what changes (here the title and the series data).
Every series has an `id`, repeated in each step. Keep the ids: the component merges series by id, and without them the steps do not reach the series and the chart stays empty.
Bind `baseOption.timeline.data` to the step names and `options` to a list with one `{title, series}` object per step, in the same order.
Set `baseOption.timeline.autoPlay` to false to start paused; `playInterval` is the time per step in milliseconds.

label: Waterfall
description: Floating bars that step from a starting value to an end value. An invisible series underneath lifts each bar to where it starts.
howTo: Two stacked series: `Offset` is invisible and lifts each visible bar. Bind `series[1].data` to the bar heights and `series[0].data` to where each bar starts (0 for the first and last bar).
For a falling waterfall the offset of bar n is the first value minus all losses up to and including n. Compute both lists in one script transform so they stay in step.

label: Bars with Background Track
description: Horizontal rounded bars drawn over a pale full-length track, read as progress towards a maximum.
howTo: Bind `yAxis.data` to the names and `series[0].data` to percentages. `xAxis.max` is the full length of the track.
